title: Evaluating AI Claims & Epistemic Stance
goal: Use negated formal opinion verbs with compound and past subjunctives and contrast them with open factual questions.
grammar: opinion verbs and mood across tenses (opinion-verbs-mood)

items: I can evaluate past or completed AI claims with *no considero que* + perfect subjunctive and *no creía que* + imperfect subjunctive.
I can contrast negated scepticism (subjunctive) with asserted opinions and open factual questions (indicative).
I can use core vocabulary for artificial intelligence, algorithms, algorithmic bias, opacity and predictive models.
